notes.title: UPDATE 9 (PHOTO MODE)
notes.content:
Photo mode has now been added, now just press the T key to switch to photo mode. I guess this changes everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244219/d79a32ccfccb415289c2c7b6b6fca368c4c1ae2c.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 8 (Important)
notes.content:
1. Three new achievements have been added.

2. Now the spouse will help the player to attack the enemy.

3. Now Bear and Scorpion will actively attack the player.

4. The turning of animals is now more natural.

5. Now the player can hold the little fox in his mouth.

6. Optimize the idle animation of tucano.

7. Now the player and spouse will not cause damage to each other.

8. Now AI foxes will increase their HP after being fed small animals.

9. Now the AI fox will automatically restore HP after a period of time after being attacked.

10. Optimized the tutorial level.

notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
1. Add two new quest.

2. Now when the player fox is older than 4 years old, the location of other AI foxes will be displayed on the map.

3. Performance optimization.

4. UI update.

notes.title: Quest System Added (Update 6)
notes.content:
1. A new quest system has been added.

2. Fixed the black screen BUG under low-quality graphics.

notes.title: Update 5(Important)
notes.content:
1. The performance is greatly optimized, and it can now increase by about 10 FPS.

2. Add two new animals: camel and scorpion.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content: Three new animals have been added: tucano, pig, and bear.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
1. Low-quality effect update.

2. Terrain optimization.

3. The carcasses of killed animals can now be eaten.

4. Increased the time required for foxes to grow one year old.

5. UI optimization.

notes.title: New ability system, turtle and deer (Important Update 2)
notes.content:
1. Now a new ability system has been added. You can get experience points by catching/killing other animals. These experience points can be exchanged for stars to upgrade your abilities.

2. Now two new animals are added, turtles and deer.

3. The AI system has been greatly optimized.

4. The fog effect is optimized.

5. UI optimization.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
1. Two new plants have been added.

2. Added the option to turn off mouse smoothing.

3. Added tutorial level tips.

4. Optimized the ghosting problem of grass and trees.

5. UI optimization.

6. Performance optimization.

7. Reduced the default mouse rotation speed.
